summary: First-finish smoke test. Backend auth/roles/CRUD largely work. One HIGH bug: POST /api/admin/teachers returns 500 due to Mongo ObjectId serialization even though the teacher is created — this blocks the frontend admin 'Criar professor' flow (modal never closes; visible 500 error banner; new teacher not shown). Frontend login (admin/teacher), wrong-password error, modal open, and route protection all work.
passed: Admin creates teacher (row persists in DB and appears on reload) — but response fails (see failed)
POST /api/instrumentos with questoes → 200 (field name is 'dom', not 'dominio' as per spec)
Frontend /login: wrong password shows 'Credenciais inválidas' error
Frontend testids present: teacher-nome, teacher-email, teacher-password, teacher-disciplina, teacher-ano, teacher-turma

failed.issue: POST /api/admin/teachers returns 500 Internal Server Error while still creating the record. Backend log: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')] in fastapi jsonable_encoder → serialize_response. Root cause is the returned Mongo document containing '_id' ObjectId being sent back without projection/model_dump.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/admin/teachers → HTTP 500 body 'Internal Server Error'; subsequent GET list shows the created teacher; backend supervisor log shows the traceback.

failed.issue: Create-teacher modal never closes and admin list is not refreshed because the api.post('/admin/teachers') call throws on 500. A red error banner is shown ('Requisição falhou com o código 500') and the created teacher is not visible. This blocks the entire admin → teacher onboarding UX even though the DB write succeeded.
failed.evidence: Playwright: after filling teacher-nome/email/password and clicking 'Criar conta', modal_open=True, new email not in body; screenshot shows error banner.

failed.issue: Instrumento question schema uses field 'dom' (not 'dominio' as stated in the review request). Not a bug per se — code and frontend use 'dom' — but spec/test request is inconsistent. Frontend Instrumentos section likely uses q-dom-N which matches 'dom'.

action_items: Fix POST /api/admin/teachers response serialization in /app/backend/server.py — return a Pydantic model (e.g., UserOut) or strip _id before returning. Same pattern should be reviewed for any other endpoint returning raw Mongo docs.
After fixing, re-verify admin 'Criar professor' UI flow end-to-end: modal closes, list refreshes, and just-created credentials popup appears.
Clarify docs/spec: instrument question field is 'dom' (backend + frontend). Update review spec accordingly.
